subject.title: Discord: Support messageUpdate and messageDelete events for edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel

question: Should Discord edit-to-reprocess and delete-to-cancel be default-on behavior for existing Discord users, or should it be gated by an explicit setting or narrower semantics?
rationale: This changes how native Discord edits and deletes control active agent work in an M4 Stable channel, and the active PR still has product/proof gates rather than only a mechanical code gap.

options.title: Accept default-on semantics
options.body: Proceed with the linked PR once correctness and live Discord proof are resolved, treating native edit/delete as expected Discord behavior.

options.title: Require opt-in or narrower behavior
options.body: Ask the linked PR to gate edit/delete handling or reduce scope before landing so existing Discord operators do not get behavior changes by default.

options.title: Defer for cross-channel design
options.body: Keep this open as product-direction work until broader recall/edit lifecycle semantics are settled with https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/55691.

recommendation.title: Accept default-on semantics
recommendation.body: Proceed with the linked PR once correctness and live Discord proof are resolved, treating native edit/delete as expected Discord behavior.

likelyOwner.reason: Current path history shows the strongest recent ownership signal for the Discord monitor/listener/startup surface.
